Yes. The most directly relevant result is RegSpeech12, a public corpus of Bengali spontaneous speech built across regional dialects for documenting phonetic and morphological variation and supporting dialect-specific ASR research [1]. A related system paper, BanglaTalk, uses the RegSpeech12 dataset and trains dialect-aware ASR for ten Bengali regional dialects, showing it is spoken regional speech data rather than only text [3].

If you want other Bangla regional-language resources, most of the rest are not spoken regional speech datasets. 5-Dialects-BN and BanglaDial-Abuse are dialectal text datasets, not speech [2,5]. BanglaTurn is Bangla conversational speech, but its abstract does not describe regional dialect coverage [6].
